images.filename: 002MA Friso.jpg
images.caption: Triple-Bodied Monster on the west pediment of the Old Temple of Athena. It's about a creature composed of three male figures joined at the waist. The first figure holds in its left hand water, the second fire, and the third a bird (symbolizing air). The monster ends in a body with shape of serpent. West pediment of the Old Temple of Athena or perhaps of the Hekatompedon. Lenormant fragment.
